It records command_spec.json from reservation PID/birth/argv, query/model/source/core/input identity; core_proof.json from actual loaded module origin/hash; command.exit.json with in_process_completed and explicit waited_child_exit not_applicable_synchronous_owner. quantitative_freeze_2026_10_04.registered_before: Any post-chain computation; new utility path declared before additive source manifest.
quantitative_freeze_2026_10_04.source_policy: Only already-published scored metrics/prediction outputs, original pyCycle evidence and fresh G0 comparison outputs. Never reopen sealed study labels or compute a second held-out score.
quantitative_freeze_2026_10_04.missing: INCOMPLETE/nonzero; no placeholder values or prose results draft.
quantitative_freeze_2026_10_04.publication: Standalone scientific figures with source-data hashes and frozen model/registration/source/core references; root verifies all expected artifacts and source/protected integrity before local tag freeze-2026-10-18. No push.
quantitative_freeze_2026_10_04.failed_complete: Explicit metadata-only validate_consumer_terminal(...,allow_scientific_fail=True) may package a fully computed scientific FAIL retaining FAIL/nonzero. Requires execution_complete true, scientific_verdict FAIL, no errors/drift/provenance/coverage defect, complete expected artifact hashes and exact command/reservation/release joins. It never authorizes deployment or a held-out score. ERROR/partial remains INCOMPLETE.
quantitative_freeze_2026_10_04.formats: Each of the eight figure prefixes has standalone PNG and PDF exports. NUMBERS.md contains only published numerical/categorical metrics and units with producer verdicts and the exact label conditional on v6 calibration. Learning/parity metrics retain complete, requested_rows, conditional_valid_rows and invalid_rows; incomplete finite error metrics are labelled conditional on valid rows, never full-domain acceptance. Missing coverage or numerical metrics remains INCOMPLETE. Fixed-draw bands are sensitivity bands, not confidence intervals; display selection is the first twenty of the published conditional rank. Fully computed internal-study diagnostic bands may be packaged after strict released-terminal validation if finite with all64 draws; preserve and visibly count every diagnostic flag and retain the source verdict. Never rank new predictions, hide diagnostic flags or reclassify invalid_prediction/invalid_thermo/nonfinite/incomplete groups. Scientific FAIL remains visible on figures and yields a complete quantitative FAIL/nonzero terminal.
quantitative_freeze_2026_10_04.tag_guard: Read-only --verify-receipt outputs/freeze/freeze_receipt.json --verification-receipt outputs/phase8/screening_operations/product_verification.json. It checks exact registered published inputs, complete authoritative terminal/reservation/release/command joins, committed raw hashes and frozen test PASS evidence. READY_FOR_ROOT_REVIEW never creates the tag or promotes scientific FAIL. Root alone creates the local tag after its final protected/source review.

verification_receipt.when: Registration before any computation. Actual final seven-test verification after studies, before quantitative freeze; original chain release, source-extension integration, AC and exclusive shared ownership required. Earlier synthetic-only fixture runs do not satisfy this final scientific product verification receipt.
verification_receipt.schema: Receipt status PASS, exit_code 0, waited true, passed positive integer, skipped 0, ended_utc; identity is the exact product Context identity including registration/source-extension/core/original-main/G0 hashes. test_files is the exact seven-path mapping to frozen committed file SHA256/Git mode identities. command records actual argv, workdir, absolute interpreter and interpreter_sha256, actual owner_pid/owner_birth and waited child_pid/child_birth. raw_sha256 maps the exact spec/log/exit/JUnit paths to byte hashes. Raw spec and exit repeat command, identity and test_files; raw exit additionally records status PASS/exit_code 0/waited true/passed/skipped 0/ended_utc plus command_spec_sha256, log_sha256 and junit_sha256. Exact argv ends with -v,--junitxml=outputs/phase8/screening_operations/product_verification_run/junit.xml after the seven registered files in order. No selection/filter/skip option or unsupported registration CLI flag. The raw pytest log and actual JUnit must agree: tests total equals passed positive count, testcase count matches, failures/errors/skipped are zero. All records and test sources must be committed unchanged. No invented or pending PASS receipt.
